doc: A random 64x32 float32 field resampled to width 96 by sample_equirect at the texel-center directions (bilinear, longitude wraps, latitude clamps, no prefiltering: a downsample aliases): float64 interpolation rounded to float32, default tolerance (measured worst difference against an analytic-index float64 evaluation 1.1e-7, one ulp). The first and last output rows lie above/below the first/last source row centers: the pole rows repeat (latitude clamp).
